summary: Iteration-3 re-test of the plan-reader/placement layer. NEW SUITE /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_regression.py (12 cases, 12 PASS) confirms the HIGH-priority sparse-geometry bbox regression is FIXED: _synthetic_plan.pdf now returns geometryAvailable=true with 'Ground Floor Plan' bbox [560,270,900,525] (340x255, hasGeometry=true) and /api/plan/placement (A-4, 22.5m, 7x437, kitchen+sprinkler) returns available=true, block covers 17.3% of the page, 16 points. digigov.pdf still good end-to-end (extract 200 in 11s, Type1/2/3 all true, clean odps_inward_no ODPS/2025/120600 + planReference scale 1:200, placement available in 0.17s cached, 247 sprinkler markers <=250, overlayNote + sideTable + legend). Floor-page selection fixed: kasturba.pdf now yields 'Ground Floor' isFloorPlan+hasGeometry (bbox 556x270) alongside 'Key Plan'; almakka.pdf has a non-degenerate 'Floor Plan' block (512x745, hasGeometry) with unit='ft' and nts=true on all floor blocks. Legacy suite /app/backend/tests/test_real_plans.py now 19/19 PASS after updating 2 stale assertions (see updated_files). Frontend: /confirm?manual=true testids all present and the flow reaches a valid /results report (after also filling the per-floor area inputs); fit-to-block on digigov auto-zooms to scale 1.2396 with the image FILLING the 735x520 viewport (img rect -70,-29 908x642 -> pan correctly clamped, no dead space) and all 4 viewer buttons change the transform; placement-overlay-note/side-table/legend all render. /manual (A-4, 20m, 3x500) gives a standard report with NONE of report-plan-reference/report-equipment-quantities/report-equipment-placement.

minor.issue: Non-floor block 'Area Statement' (block-1) still gets a zero-WIDTH bbox [560.0,270.0,560.0,525.0] (all region lines share one x). Harmless today (hasGeometry=false, not used for placement) but a min-span clamp in _block_bbox_around would make it honest.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, verified NOT a bug: the new text scorer now picks page 2 (5 strong floor titles) whose sheet scale is genuinely 1:100, so per-block scaleNote is 1:100 while planReference.scale (title-block page 0) stays 1:200. Two scales shown in the same report may confuse users - consider labelling the block scale as 'sheet scale of the floor-plan page'.

The two 'Ground Floor Plan'/'Ground Floor' blocks have hasGeometry=false and a squat bbox anchored at x0=0 (e.g. [0,3206,826,3370]); only the generic 'Floor Plan' block is usable. Anchor-region growth still under-covers those titles.
PRE-EXISTING engine bug (400 on valid payload). Endpoint is now unused by the UI - not re-investigated per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH-ish for the requested flow: filling only confirm-building-type/total-area/num-floors/height leaves 'Confirm & Analyze' DISABLED (gate is form.floorAreas.every(a=>!a)). Total Floor Area is never distributed into the per-floor inputs and there is no visible message explaining why the button is disabled, so the user is stuck with a greyed button. Suggested fix: derive per-floor areas from totalArea/numberOfFloors (or accept totalArea alone) and render a validation hint.
Duplicate data-testid 'input-project-name' appears twice on the page (strict-mode locator hazard for future tests).
Report title is hard-coded 'Mixed-Occupancy Building' even in SINGLE-occupancy mode (still open from iteration_2).

issues: The side table is clipped mid-row at its bottom edge ('IS 2190:2024' row cut in half) with no visible scrollbar affordance - add max-height with overflow-y:auto plus a fade/scroll hint.
Fit-to-block now correctly fills the viewport with pan clamped (verified: scaled image 908x642 vs viewer 735x520), no dead space. No new issues.

De-duplicate data-testid 'input-project-name' on /manual; rename report title when occupancy mode is SINGLE.
critical_code_review_comments: scale_detector._block_bbox_around: the >=20-segment guard plus degenerate fallback fixes the regression, but the no-trim path still returns the raw min/max with no minimum-span clamp - a single-column region yields a zero-area box.

routes/plan.py _choose_floor_page_by_text uses substring counts ('FLOOR PLAN' also matches inside 'GROUND FLOOR PLAN'), so scores double-count; it works today but is fragile - score distinct titles instead.
plan_reader/store.py is still an unbounded in-memory dict (full PDF bytes + rendered PNG per upload, no TTL/size cap) - memory grows per session.
confirm/page.tsx submit gate and handleSubmit duplicate the same validation logic; single-source it and surface the reason in the UI instead of only disabling the button.

rca_of_the_issue: The iteration-2 regression was caused by percentile-trimming segment midpoints unconditionally in _block_bbox_around. The fix now (a) computes the full endpoint bbox as the baseline, (b) applies the 8th-92nd percentile trim only when len(region_lines) >= 20, and (c) falls back to the full bbox when the trimmed box is <20px in either axis. Verified: synthetic fixture geometryAvailable=true with a 340x255 ground-floor bbox and placement available, while digigov keeps a tight block (17% of the sheet) - so the fix restores sparse-geometry plans without loosening dense CAD sheets. Remaining /confirm blocker is a validation/UX gap (submit gated on floorAreas), not a backend defect.
